name: campusbuzz-dev
description: CampusBuzz local development commands. Cross-platform: identical on Windows (cmd/PowerShell), macOS and Linux. No `make`, no bash required.

scripts.setup: flutter pub get && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-campusbuzz
scripts.analyze: flutter analyze && npm --prefix functions run lint
